title: Tightening Fence Wire with Tool
reason: Demonstrates the process of tightening a loose strand of barbed wire using a wire tucker.

tasks.task: Show the process of using a wire tucker to tighten barbed wire.

subtasks.text: Observe the barbed wire that has become loose.
Note the device called a wire tucker being prepared for use.
Watch the wire tucker being attached to the fence barbed wire.
Notice the fence barbed wire becoming tight after using the wire tucker.
Observe the speaker emphasizing that the wire is now as tight as a banjo string.
